Variants.Content: Old Wyk is located in the Iron Islands and is a sacred place for the belief in the Drowned God and the memory of the ancient kingship of the Ironborn. The legendary sea dragon ribs are displayed on the Naga Hills, where the Ironborn once held the King Selection; the island has a barren land, but it has a status that far exceeds its economic scale due to religious traditions.
Entry Old Wyk Local families also relied on salt fish, ore, barren fields, sheltered anchorages, and longships to return home; if any road, well, or dock failed, the price would fall first on them.

Entry Old Wyk They will also recognize the accents, laws and credentials of the Iron Islands; reputations may travel great distances from taverns, but true distances must still be measured by wheel, oar or horse's hoof.

Entry Old Wyk If you can supply supplies, avoid danger, and find a guide, it is worth marking in your itinerary; if you don't have these three things, no matter how loud your family name is, it won't be able to save the lost.
Entry Old Wyk A stronghold was therefore not just a lord's hall, but also a place where weddings and funerals, vows, labor and local memories recurred.

Entry Old Wyk They care about salt fish, ore, barren fields, sheltered anchorages, and the return of longships. They also look at whether seeds are left after collecting grain and whether the city gates are open in times of disaster. When people from afar see coats of arms, what they see is whether there will be food to eat tomorrow.
